mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the prior 3 months compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns as lower rates increase present value of future cash flows.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25% over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.5% signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE rises above 4.5% in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad-based consumer demand contraction, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days due to reduced economic activity.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Active monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS rising at least 0.5% over 3 months) increases discount rates and reduces liquidity, causing S&P 500 underperformance over the subsequent 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises by 0.5% or more in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) over the prior 3 months signals weakening economic output, reducing corporate profitability and predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when INDPRO declines by at least 0.5% over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) falling below 1700 thousand units in a month signals housing market weakness, reducing consumer confidence and business investment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST is below 1700.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates labor market deterioration under monetary tightening, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of PAYEMS decline and FEDFUNDS rise fails to predict negative returns: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions (UNRATE < 4.5% and falling), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals economic overheating followed by slowdown, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 4.5% and UNRATE falls > 0.1pp in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE is below 4.5% and falling, and INDPRO declines.
